chansons.style: Smooth jazz lounge, brushed drums, upright bass, breathy saxophone, warm male vocal, intimate romantic late night vibe, 85 BPM
chansons.resume_fr: Une ballade douce sur l'attente et la connexion indéfectible entre deux amants séparés par l'océan.
chansons.paroles:
[Intro]
(Soft brush sweeps, walking bass)

[Verse 1]
The clock is ticking on the wall
I watch the evening shadows fall
A thousand miles across the sea
You are the only one for me
The city lights begin to glow
But I have nowhere else to go

[Pre-Chorus]
I trace your name upon the glass
And watch the lonely hours pass

[Chorus]
Miles away, but in my heart
Distance cannot keep us apart
Miles away, beneath the moon
I will be with you soon

[Verse 2]
The coffee cup is getting cold
A story that is left untold
I hear your voice upon the phone
It makes me feel I'm not alone
I close my eyes and see your face
And dream of our embracing space

[Pre-Chorus]
I trace your name upon the glass
And watch the lonely hours pass

[Chorus]
Miles away, but in my heart
Distance cannot keep us apart
Miles away, beneath the moon
I will be with you soon

[Bridge]
(Saxophone solo, smooth and low)
Every letter, every sigh
Reaches up into the sky
Waiting for the morning light
To hold you in the velvet night

[Chorus]
Miles away, but in my heart
Distance cannot keep us apart
Miles away, beneath the moon
I will be with you soon

[Outro]
I will be with you soon
So very soon
(Fade out with bass and brushes)
